title: ID0377867-DC/Si-D/FI [MP / R5 170002027] DC2 does not work due to bender failure
description:
Location:  Porvoo, Finland
Reported behaviour/issue:
DC2 does not work always. Socket is toggling between available and OoO due to bender modbus error. This started after FW was downgraded from 5.x.19 back to version 4.
Root cause: Faulty IMD_BC2
Solution: Replace IMD
On DAMEX Sanctioned List:Siemens
Warranty Status:Yes
NOTE TO QM: RC is replying with the missing information.
Action:
Site visit 4.9.2024. Wirings check -→ Ok. Bender settings check -→ Ok. After bender replacement, issue was fixed.
